title: ROADMAP DEBT PAYMENT WARDROBE
description: The patch claims to simplify progression, then decides whose confusion counts as acceptable loss. Three long-promised fixes ship with direct patch notes, no event wrapper, and no commemorative bundle. Outfits now include prestige variants, matching effects, and a bundle preview that understands insecurity.
consequence: Players reacted with suspicion to a promise being kept in daylight. Self-expression gained tiers, timers, and a receipt.

title: ROADMAP DEBT PAYMENT COOLDOWN
description: The change decides which delays are atmosphere and which delays are invoices. Three long-promised fixes ship with direct patch notes, no event wrapper, and no commemorative bundle. Limited-time labels and countdown nudges have been softened across the event shop.
consequence: Players reacted with suspicion to a promise being kept in daylight. Players felt less hunted. The dashboard noticed immediately.

title: ASPIRATIONAL ROADMAP REFRESH WARDROBE
description: The feature moves a player-facing convenience into the same room as a business goal. Previously announced features have been reframed as directional pillars while the team evaluates delivery confidence. Outfits now include prestige variants, matching effects, and a bundle preview that understands insecurity.
consequence: The roadmap survived by becoming less related to roads. Self-expression gained tiers, timers, and a receipt.
